snippet.title: Pizza Bandit Early Access release date trailer - PC Gaming Show 2025
snippet.description:
Pizza? Check. Ultra-violent third-person shooting? Check. A new genre we've named the shooter/cooker? Well, maybe, but that's up to you. Pizza Bandit bursts onto Early Access on August 25.
